title: Advertising & Wants Adventure
welcome_lead: Adverts turn wants into 'must-haves'. Spot the tricks. 📣
meta_desc: Needs vs Wants Adventure 2 — KS3 Economics on how marketing creates wants.
final_note: You learned how adverts create wants and how to think critically as a customer.

concepts.def: Social media star who promotes products

walkthroughs.body_html:
Advertising can make a want feel like a need.

You didn't need that hoodie this morning — then you saw it on TikTok. 🎯

Common tricks:

  • FOMO — 'only 3 left!'
  • Influencers wearing a brand.
  • Peer pressure — your mates have one.
  • Discount codes that feel urgent.

Use critical thinking:

  • Do I need this or just want it?
  • Will I still want it in a week?
  • Could I get it cheaper or second-hand?
  • Is this advert trying to play me?

Small pauses save big money. ⏸️
